topics.title: Monorepo ownership and change routing
topics.summary: Route work by owned runtime surface and preserve atomic cross-component changes.
search: find apps services packages research infra -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort
invariants: One repository commit is the source identity for every affected component.
Do not recreate cross-repository synchronization for code already in this tree.

topics.title: Isolated worktrees and stacked pull requests
topics.summary: Use one lightweight monorepo worktree and a noninteractive gh stack.
invariants: Never mutate a dirty source checkout to obtain isolation.
Never merge unless the user separately authorizes it.

topics.title: Validator, miner CLI, chain, and Compose runtime
topics.summary: The validator evaluates leased jobs and sets weights; the miner CLI packages, pays for, and uploads agents.
invariants: The validator is stateless; durable queue and score state belong to Platform.
Never expose signing material or provider credentials to untrusted jobs.

topics.title: W&B validator and worker operations
topics.summary: Query bounded W&B run evidence through the authenticated API, then corroborate it with Platform or chain truth.
invariants: Never print or inspect the W&B API key or dump run configs.
W&B is diagnostic telemetry; Platform and chain state remain authoritative.

topics.title: Private Python and Go runtime profiling
topics.summary: Capture private Python and Go sampling evidence through IAP SSH or authenticated Backroom relay controls, interpret exact running stacks, and compare equivalent before-and-after profiles.
invariants: Profiler listeners remain non-configurable loopback sockets reached only through checked-in IAP tooling or authenticated Backroom capture; never publish or proxy them.
Record exact deployed identity and representative workload; local source or an idle sample does not prove a live performance win.

topics.title: Platform API, database, migrations, and queue control
topics.summary: Platform owns HTTP contracts, durable state, scheduling, admission, leases, and administrative control.
validate: cd apps/platform && make lint lint-copy typecheck test
invariants: Alembic must have exactly one head and hot-table migrations must use the safe helpers.
Platform API changes mark Backroom affected; dashboard-only changes do not.

topics.title: Platform operator dashboard
topics.summary: The Platform dashboard visualizes public and operator-facing Platform data without owning API semantics.
invariants: Dashboard-only changes do not affect Backroom release selection.
Displayed rank and score semantics must come from authoritative Platform responses.

topics.title: Public subnet Backroom Worker
topics.summary: The public SN118 operator console runs as a Cloudflare Worker and calls Platform administrative APIs.
invariants: Keep OAuth, administrator lists, sessions, and Platform tokens out of browser code.
Generate the Platform contract locally; never dispatch to a sibling repository.

topics.title: Screener queue, autoscaling, Targon, GCE, and trusted builds
topics.summary: Platform queues work; the fenced controller reconciles Targon-first capacity with bounded GCE fallback and a separate trusted builder.
invariants: Targon is primary and GCE normally targets zero; fallback remains bounded and independently fenced.
Untrusted builds never receive cloud, GitHub, Platform, or provider credentials.

topics.title: DittoBench execution, v8 scoring, and inference relay
topics.summary: DittoBench executes untrusted harnesses, enforces protocol contracts, and computes the versioned score consumed by validators.
invariants: Research adapters do not create alternate production scoring paths.
Any scoring change must preserve explicit version negotiation and frozen calibration inputs.

topics.title: Datagen research and third-party benchmark adapters
topics.summary: Research data, calibration evidence, and third-party adapters live beside DittoBench but outside production score semantics unless deliberately promoted.
invariants: Keep raw evidence and reproducible manifests with research conclusions.
Do not change v8 scoring merely to improve an adapter result.

topics.title: Cross-component protocols and generated contracts
topics.summary: Shared wire and screening contracts must change atomically with every producer, consumer, generated artifact, and compatibility test.
validate: cd apps/backroom && pnpm check && pnpm test
invariants: Change producers and consumers in one stack, not through bot PRs.
Generated artifacts must identify the same monorepo revision as their source.

topics.title: Affected components, semantic release, builds, and deployments
topics.summary: The affected-component graph selects versioned artifacts and automatic application deploys from one exact release commit.
invariants: A fix releases every affected component; infra changes remain protected plan/apply.
API changes affect Backroom, dashboard-only changes do not.

topics.title: GCP, Cloudflare, Terraform, Ansible, and secrets
topics.summary: Terraform owns reviewed cloud state; GitHub OIDC identities deploy applications; Ansible converges hosts; secrets stay in provider stores.
invariants: Never read, print, or persist provider secret values while testing integrations.
Automatic app deploys and protected infrastructure apply are separate authority boundaries.
